title: Serum iron–bilirubin interaction did not establish improved cross-cycle CRP prediction beyond flexible marginal measures
abstract: A standardized serum iron-by-bilirubin interaction did not establish incremental log-CRP prediction from NHANES 2007–2008 to separately sampled 2009–2010 adults: weighted MSE reduction -0.004458 log-squared units; two-sample preprocessing-and-coefficient-refit PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.013801, 0.001771].
